checkedInvariants.requirement: Real TCP cleanup evidence, not child-exit inference
checkedInvariants.details: Single bounded loopback127.0.0.1:5194 observation after resource closure. Connect=true; ECONNREFUSED=false; timeout/other error/invalid monotonic order=null. Driver stores receipt and marks true/null as cleanup error. Wrapper passes the actual listening value to the unchanged process outcome adapter, conditional on actual preview child exit, instead of manufacturing false. Observation is transient TCP evidence, not persistent absence or foreign-process ownership; no foreign listener is terminated.

Node monotonic endpoint brackets and actual completion-to-completion denominator are separate from browser marks. CPU includes trace/control/shared endpoint perturbation and is whole-process, not callback, continuous lossless coverage or native DSP.

checkedInvariants.details: Uses existing formal stream analyzer/unchanged numeric, actual raw UI membership and fixed workloads. Probe-off is comparison-only. The classifier's possible QUALIFIED_MEASUREMENT is scoped ORIGINAL_UI_PHYSICS_ACOUSTIC_PROFILE_ONLY, not overallPERF014, native DSP, hearing or V1 completion. knownScopeLimitations.details: completeMainThreadDelivery remains UNVERIFIED. CombinedDelivery is KNOWN_STAGE_SUM_ONLY; receiveThroughNativeConsumers covers actual receive entry through native consumers but not pre-handler deserialization/OS dispatch or LabRuntime-specific bookkeeping. Passing those local metrics must not be reported as canonical complete main-thread delivery p95<1ms, nor as all ofPERF014 passing. This review does not expand the classifier's existing limited contract.

Code/helper source tests cannot establish actual SystemInfo counters, Win32 access/creation/PID coverage, endpoint perturbation, process churn, graphics capacity, long wall duration, whole native DSP cost, hardware underruns or hearing. nativeDspCpuMs remains null. Existing record grants no lossless CPU scope.

Probe-off preserves normal product monitor and active shared resource/CPU endpoints; it is a comparison arm rather than proof of zero overhead. Both arms preserve formal work and output routes. Actual paired overhead awaits scheduled native evidence.

TCP refusal applies only at the recorded cleanup endpoint. Timer is a requested trigger with monotonic receipt, not an exact global wall deadline; an unrelated listener is neither attributed nor killed.
